Q6111.reason: A general littering ban is a content-neutral O'Brien rule aimed at clean parks, so any burden on the protestor's symbolic dumping is incidental and valid.

Q5735.reason: Only a defendant may remove, so the plaintiff's removal was unauthorized and the defendant's timely remand motion sends the entire case back.

Q5651.reason: Advertising the car as a 1964 is an express warranty of description, and an as-is clause cannot disclaim that warranty even though it can exclude implied warranties.
